title: 第10章 安家陈刘庄第11章 吃一顿热饭
slug: 剑里乾坤第3107章不似作伪
content_zh:
第二天一早，老蔡表侄媳做好早饭，他们简单吃了点东西，就把马车套好了，把高碧柔和卓然送到马车里面，老蔡把表侄拉到一边说道“表侄，不要和任何人说我们在你家过夜的事情！”表侄连连点头说知道了。老蔡这才放心跳上马车，赶着马车继续赶路！
他们尽量不走大路，乡下地方没到正月十五之前，商家基本上都没开门，到处都是走亲访友的人，由于商铺都没开门，他们吃饭就成了问题，好在车上带的点心比较多，饿了就吃一点，渴了就找人家讨口水喝，顺便老蔡也会要点草料帮马喂一下，高碧柔则带着卓然下来伸展一下筋骨，就这样走了五天，高碧柔对老蔡说道“蔡叔！我们这段时间已经走了一千多里了，总是这样东跑西颠也不是个办法，您看我们能不能找个合适的地方安顿下来？”老蔡说道“我也是这样考虑的，总是这样坐在车里，也不是个事，赶路的时候我会留意的。”
中午的时间，老蔡赶着马车路过一个村庄，他把马车停在一户人家门口，这家里面住着一对四十多岁的中年夫妇，很是憨厚老实，老蔡说想要点热水喝，男主人连忙让自家女人去房间里面烧水，高碧柔则带着卓然下车舒展一下身体，顺便也去厕所方便一下，男主人比较健谈，他对老蔡说道“老哥！这是从哪里来呀？走亲戚还是办事的呀？”老蔡闻言叹了一口气说道“大兄弟！不瞒你说，我家老爷是一名军官，前段时间在战场上战死了，留下这孤儿寡母的，就去投奔远房表哥，谁知这表哥家搬走了，一时半会也打听不到消息，正发愁该怎么办呢！”那中年男人说道“我有两个儿子，大儿子在城里做点小生意，小儿子去年也去从军了，现在就我和老婆子两人在家，说不定我小儿子还认识你家老爷呢？”老蔡呵呵一笑说道“这也说不定，大兄弟您贵姓啊？怎么称呼啊？”那中年男人说道“我姓刘，排行老五，他们都喊我刘五，您也喊我刘五就行了！”老蔡呵呵一笑说道“那我就不客气了刘五兄弟！这个村子里面有没有人家房子要买，或者对外出租的呀？”刘五一拍大腿说道“你算问对人了，年前我一个本家兄弟搬到镇上去住了，委托我帮他房子卖了，房子也不小就是有点偏僻了，在村子的最西头。”老蔡闻言连忙说道“刘五兄弟！我喊上夫人一起去看看，你看行不？”刘五连连点头！
去看房子的路上，刘五不断的和路上的行人打着招呼，可见刘五在这村里人缘还是不错的，路上刘五告诉他们这个村叫“陈刘庄”村里基本上都姓陈姓刘，这个村子比较大，大约有二千多人！很快他们就通过一座小石桥，来到一座紧挨着山脚下的小四合院门，在四合院的前面还有一条小溪，只不过现在的溪水已经结冰了，刘五从身上拿出钥匙打开了院门，高碧柔一眼就喜欢上这座小院子了，小院里面收拾的很是利索，三间正房面北朝南，东西两侧各有两间配房，院子里面还有一口井。房间里面家具桌椅板凳，锅碗瓢盆什么都是齐全的。这座院子因为门口有一条小溪，相对比较独立一点。刘五说道“老哥！您看这宅院行不行啊？偏是有点偏了，但是房子盖好没有多长时间，我那本家兄弟这两年在镇上做生意赚到钱了，于是就在镇上买了房子，这房子就空下来了！”老蔡看了看高碧柔说道“夫人！您看这座宅院怎么样？”高碧柔点了点头说道“蔡叔您做主就可以了？”于是老蔡回头对刘五说道“大兄弟！你看这宅子要卖多少两银子啊？”刘五说道“我那兄弟说了，五十两银子就卖了！”老蔡回头看了一下高碧柔，就见高碧柔轻轻的点了点头！老蔡说道“大兄弟！这房子我们买了！这银子什么时候给你呀？”刘五说道“这样吧你们先搬进来住，我现在就去城里把我兄弟喊回来，让他带上房契，你们一手交钱，一手交货！”老蔡说道“这样也好！我们现在就过去把马车赶过来，这事就拜托兄弟了！事情办成以后老哥请你喝酒！”
他们回到刘五家，简单喝了点水，老蔡就赶着马车带上高碧柔和卓然就来到那个宅院，他们把马车上面的被子还有那些东西全部，都搬到房间里面。高碧柔和卓然住在正房，老蔡住在侧房，小卓然则一个人在院子里面玩耍，高碧柔从小到大就没做过家务，但是她此刻却是没有一点抱怨，尽力的去做以前她没做过的事！老蔡则把院子里面的卫生打扫了一下，由于没有粮油米面，所以忙完以后，他们没有办法做饭，他们就拿出点心来准备一起吃点，就在这时刘五带着一位中年男子走了过来，他一进门就对老蔡说道“老哥！这位就是我兄弟也是这房子的主人，我专门去镇上把他带过来，你们一手交钱一手交货吧？”老蔡连忙对那中年男人抱了抱拳，坐下来以后按照刘五谈好的价格，高碧柔从包袱里面掏出五十两银子放到桌子上面，那人则把一张房契也放到了桌子上面，同时他还拿出一张写好的卖房契约和一盒印泥，老蔡和那男人都在契约上按了手印！就这样房子成功买卖成功，那男子见他们只吃点心并没做饭，于是他从掏出点碎银子给刘五说道“五哥！买房子你也辛苦了，这些碎银子给你买点茶叶喝，他们没做饭，你带回去做点吃的帮我招待他们一下！我还有事就先回去了！”说完他就站了起来，老蔡和刘五也站起来把他送了出去，刘五对老蔡说道“老哥！带上夫人和小少爷去我家，让我媳妇做点热的给你们吃！”高碧柔不想给刘五添麻烦，于是说道“我们在家对付一口就可以了，就不去打搅您了！”刘五闻言哈哈大笑说道“这有什么打搅的呀，只要你们不嫌弃就行了，这天吃点热的暖和！”架不住刘五的热情，他们也就没在推迟，来到了刘五家！
content_en:
Early the next morning, Lao Cai's cousin and his wife made breakfast. They ate something simple, then hitched up the carriage and sent Gao Birou and Zhuoran into the carriage. Lao Cai pulled his cousin aside and said, "Cousin, don't tell anyone about us spending the night at your house!" The cousin nodded repeatedly and said he understood. Only then did Lao Cai get on the carriage with confidence and drive the carriage on his way!
They tried not to walk on the main road. In the countryside, businesses were basically closed before the fifteenth day of the first lunar month. People visiting relatives and friends were everywhere. Since the shops were closed, eating became a problem for them. Fortunately, they brought more snacks in the car. They ate some when they were hungry. When they were thirsty, they asked others for water. By the way, Lao Cai would also ask for some fodder to feed the horses. Gao Birou came down with Zhuo Ran. After stretching his muscles and walking like this for five days, Gao Birou said to Lao Cai, "Uncle Cai! We have traveled more than a thousand miles during this period. Running around like this all the time is not an option. Do you think we can find a suitable place to settle down?" Lao Cai said, "I also thought about it. Sitting in the car like this all the time is not a problem. I will pay attention to it when I am on the road."
At noon, Lao Cai drove his carriage through a village. He parked the carriage in front of a house where a middle-aged couple in their forties lived. They were very honest and honest. Lao Cai said he wanted some hot water. The man quickly asked his wife to boil water in the room. Gao Birou took Zhuo Ran out of the car to stretch her body and go to the toilet for convenience. The man was quite talkative and said to Lao Cai, "Brother! Where did this come from? Are you a relative?" Lao Cai sighed and said, "Brother! To tell you the truth, my father was an officer and died on the battlefield some time ago. He left this orphan and went to live with his distant cousin. Unexpectedly, the cousin's family moved away and he couldn't find any news for a while. He was worried about what to do!" I'm doing some small business here. My younger son also joined the army last year. Now my wife and I are at home. Maybe my younger son still knows your father?" Lao Cai chuckled and said, "That's not sure. What's your surname, brother?" Brother! Are there any houses in this village that you want to buy or rent?" Liu Wuyi slapped his thigh and said, "You are asking the right person. One of my brothers moved to the town and asked me to help him sell his house. The house is not small, but it is a bit remote. It is in the west end of the village." When Lao Cai heard this, he said quickly, "Brother Liu Wu! I asked my wife to come and take a look. Do you think it's okay?"
On the way to see the house, Liu Wu kept saying hello to the passers-by, which showed that Liu Wu was quite popular in the village. On the way, Liu Wu told them that the village was called "Chenliuzhuang". Basically, everyone in the village had the surname Chen and Liu. This village was relatively large, with about 2,000 people! Soon they passed a small stone bridge and came to the gate of a small courtyard close to the foot of the mountain. There was a stream in front of the courtyard, but the stream was frozen now. Liu Wu took out the key from his body and opened the door. Gao Birou fell in love with the small courtyard at first sight. The courtyard was neatly arranged, with three main rooms facing north and south, two auxiliary rooms on the east and west sides, and a well in the courtyard. The room is fully equipped with furniture, tables, chairs, benches, pots and pans. This yard is relatively independent because there is a creek at the door. Liu Wu said, "Brother! Do you think this house is okay? It's a bit out of the way, but it didn't take long after the house was built. My brother has made money doing business in the town in the past two years, soSo I bought a house in the town and it became vacant! "Lao Cai looked at Gao Birou and said, "Madam! What do you think of this house? Gao Birou nodded and said, "Uncle Cai, can you just make the decision?" So Lao Cai turned around and said to Liu Wu, "Brother!" How much do you think this house will cost? Liu Wu said, "My brother said, I sold it for fifty taels of silver!" "Lao Cai looked back at Gao Birou and saw Gao Birou nodded gently! Lao Cai said, "Brother! We bought this house! When will I give you this money? "Liu Wu said, "Well, you guys move in first. I will go to the city to call my brother back and ask him to bring the house deed. You pay with one hand and deliver the goods with the other! "Lao Cai said, "That's fine! Let's go over and drive the carriage over now. I'll leave this to my brother! After everything is done, I’ll treat you to a drink! "
They returned to Liu Wu's house and drank some water. Lao Cai drove the carriage and took Gao Birou and Zhuoran to the house. They moved the quilt and all those things on the carriage into the room. Gao Birou lives in the main house with Zhuoran, Lao Cai lives in the side room, and Xiao Zhuoran plays alone in the yard. Gao Birou has never done housework since she was a child, but now she doesn't complain at all and tries her best to do things she has never done before! Lao Cai cleaned the yard. Since there was no grain, oil, rice or noodles, they had no way to cook after the work, so they took out snacks to eat together. At this time, Liu Wu came over with a middle-aged man. As soon as he entered the door, he said to Lao Cai, "Brother! This is my brother and the owner of this house. I went to the town to bring him here. You pay and deliver the goods, right? "Lao Cai quickly hugged the middle-aged man. After sitting down, according to the price negotiated by Liu Wu, Gao Birou took out fifty taels of silver from the bag and put it on the table. The man also put a house deed on the table, and at the same time he also took out A written house sale deed and a box of ink pads were given. Lao Cai and the man both put their fingerprints on the contract! The house was successfully sold and sold. The man saw that they only ate snacks and did not cook, so he took out some scraps of money and gave it to Liu Wu and said, "Fifth brother! You've worked hard to buy a house. I'll buy you some tea with these scraps of money. They haven't cooked, so you can take it back and make some food to help me entertain them! I'll go back if I have something else to do! "After saying that, he stood up. Lao Cai and Liu Wu also stood up and sent him out. Liu Wu said to Lao Cai, "Brother! Take your wife and young master to my house, and let my wife make something hot for you to eat! "Gao Birou didn't want to cause trouble to Liu Wu, so she said, "We can just deal with it at home and won't bother you! Liu Wu laughed loudly when he heard this and said, "What's the trouble? As long as you don't dislike it, it's fine. Eat something hot to keep warm today!" "Unable to resist Liu Wu's enthusiasm, they did not delay and came to Liu Wu's house!
